title: DANCE AND JOY Festival – Edition Bal Masqué
description:
The Passion Kizomba Nantes team is pleased to invite you to the Dance and Joy Festival – Masquerade Party Edition. From May 21 to 24, 2027. In a spacious and comfortable hotel. All in one venue
✨✨Bachata, Kizomba & Salsa✨✨
